papers.title: Lactiplantibacillus plantarum PD01 supplementation reduces microplastics and microplastic-associated chemicals in humans: A randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial.
papers.translated_title: 植物乳杆菌PD01补充剂可减少人体内的微塑料及微塑料相关化学物质：一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验。
papers.author: Lu, R.
papers.summary: BACKGROUND Plastic products improve daily convenience but release pollutants that threaten human health, and effective elimination strategies remain limited. METHODS In a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, we assessed whether Lactiplantibacillus plantarum PD01, previously isolated from a donor with high-microplastic (MP) excretion, accelerates MP elimination. Of 106 participants recruited, 96 were randomized to placebo or PD01. Fecal MPs and urinary phthalate metabolites were measured by pyrolysis-gas chromatography-mass spectrometry and liquid chromatography-mass spectrometry at baseline, week 3, and week 6. Primary outcomes were changes in MP concentrations and phthalate metabolite levels, analyzed with linear mixed-effects models. RESULTS PD01 significantly increased fecal excretion of polycarbonate (PC) and total MPs at week 3 (PC: estimated mean difference, 3.19; 95% confidence interval [CI], 0.98 to 5.40; interaction P =0.005; total MPs: 1.99; 95% CI, 0.78 to 3.21; interaction P =0.001) and week 6 (PC: 2.87; 95% CI, 0.66 to 5.08; interaction P =0.011; total MPs: 1.25; 95% CI, 0.04 to 2.47; interaction P =0.044). By week 6, urinary phthalate metabolites were significantly lower with PD01 than placebo (MnBP: -0.96; 95% CI, -1.73 to -0.18; interaction P =0.016; MEHHP: -0.91; 95% CI, -1.79 to -0.02; interaction P =0.046; MECPP: -1.06; 95% CI, -2.09 to -0.03; interaction P =0.045; {Sigma}DEHP: -0.97; 95% CI, -1.84 to -0.09; interaction P =0.031). CONCLUSIONS This trial provides a feasible, low-cost, gut-targeted strategy to accelerate pollutant clearance and represents the first clinical evidence that human plastic burden can be lowered without dietary or behavioral restrictions. (ClinicalTrials.gov: NCT07416214.)
papers.translated_summary: 背景 塑料制品提升了日常便利性，但会释放威胁人类健康的污染物，而有效的清除策略仍然有限。方法 在一项随机、双盲、安慰剂对照试验中，我们评估了此前从一名高微塑料（MP）排泄供体分离的植物乳植杆菌PD01是否能加速MP清除。在招募的106名参与者中，96人被随机分配至安慰剂组或PD01组。在基线、第3周和第6周，通过热裂解-气相色谱-质谱法和液相色谱-质谱法测定粪便MP和尿液邻苯二甲酸酯代谢物。主要结局为MP浓度和邻苯二甲酸酯代谢物水平的变化，采用线性混合效应模型分析。结果 PD01在第3周显著增加聚碳酸酯（PC）和总MP的粪便排泄（PC：估计平均差3.19；95%置信区间[CI] 0.98至5.40；交互作用P=0.005；总MP：1.99；95% CI 0.78至3.21；交互作用P=0.001）和第6周（PC：2.87；95% CI 0.66至5.08；交互作用P=0.011；总MP：1.25；95% CI 0.04至2.47；交互作用P=0.044）。至第6周，PD01组尿液邻苯二甲酸酯代谢物显著低于安慰剂组（MnBP：-0.96；95% CI -1.73至-0.18；交互作用P=0.016；MEHHP：-0.91；95% CI -1.79至-0.02；交互作用P=0.046；MECPP：-1.06；95% CI -2.09至-0.03；交互作用P=0.045；{Sigma}DEHP：-0.97；95% CI -1.84至-0.09；交互作用P=0.031）。结论 本试验提供了一种可行、低成本、靶向肠道的策略以加速污染物清除，并首次提供了临床证据，表明无需饮食或行为限制即可降低人体塑料负荷。（ClinicalTrials.gov：NCT07416214。）

papers.title: Product mix and time since cessation among Korean former smokers using non-combusted nicotine products: a KNHANES analysis with implications for lung cancer risk comparisons
papers.translated_title: 韩国前吸烟者使用非燃烧型尼古丁产品的产品组合及戒烟时长：一项KNHANES分析及其对肺癌风险比较的启示
papers.author: Cook, S. F.
papers.summary: Introduction: A Korean National Health Insurance Service (NHIS) cohort study reported higher lung cancer incidence among former smokers who used e-cigarettes after quitting than among those who quit without them. Interpreting that association requires knowing which product was used and how long ago participants quit; the cohort measured neither directly, but the contemporaneous Korea National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (KNHANES) did. Methods: KNHANES 2018, a cross-sectional national survey, used the NHIS umbrella e-cigarette term, a separate heated tobacco product (HTP) item, and months since cessation. Former smokers using either product (n = 43) were compared with those using neither (n = 1,305), with replication in 2019-2023. Results: Of adults affirming current umbrella e-cigarette use, 64% also reported HTP use (former smokers, 50%); 79% of product-using former smokers reported HTP use. Median time since cessation was eight months among product users and twelve years among others (Kolmogorov-Smirnov D = 0.76, P < 0.001). The gap was replicated in every wave through 2023 (D = 0.63-0.76) and persisted in the long-term quitter stratum (pooled 2019-2023 medians, 6 vs 18 years), in Kim et al.'s high-risk subgroup (2 vs 12 years), after age matching (residual 9.0-11.0 years) and among umbrella-item respondents only (D = 0.73). Conclusions: The reported association is consistent with residual confounding by cessation timing and with product misclassification. It also rests on few exposed events: 16 in the long-term stratum, and 31 of 71 retained when exposure was updated at the next screening. Because at most half of the exposure was exclusive liquid e-cigarette use, an e-cigarette-specific estimate would need about four times as many exposed events for the same precision. Repeated-screening designs that update cessation and product use at every screening, already used for cessation in the same database, would retain the full sample and allow more precise, product-specific dose-response estimates.
papers.translated_summary: 引言：一项韩国国民健康保险服务（NHIS）队列研究报告称，戒烟后使用电子烟的既往吸烟者，其肺癌发病率高于未使用电子烟而戒烟的既往吸烟者。解读这一关联需要了解使用的是哪种产品以及参与者戒烟多久；该队列研究并未直接测量这两项，但同期的韩国国民健康与营养调查（KNHANES）进行了测量。方法：KNHANES 2018是一项横断面全国调查，使用了NHIS的电子烟统称术语、单独的加热烟草制品（HTP）条目以及戒烟月数。使用任一产品的既往吸烟者（n = 43）与两者均不使用者（n = 1,305）进行比较，并在2019-2023年进行重复验证。结果：在确认当前使用统称电子烟的成年人中，64%同时报告使用HTP（既往吸烟者中为50%）；使用产品的既往吸烟者中有79%报告使用HTP。使用产品者戒烟时间中位数为八个月，其他人为十二年（Kolmogorov-Smirnov D = 0.76，P < 0.001）。这一差距在截至2023年的每一轮调查中均得到重复验证（D = 0.63-0.76），并在长期戒烟者分层中持续存在（2019-2023年合并中位数，6年 vs 18年），在Kim等人的高风险亚组中（2年 vs 12年），在年龄匹配后（残差9.0-11.0年）以及在仅统称条目应答者中（D = 0.73）均持续存在。结论：所报告的关联与戒烟时间的残余混杂和产品错误分类相一致。该关联还依赖于很少的暴露事件：长期分层中为16例，当在下次筛查时更新暴露情况时，71例中保留了31例。由于最多只有一半的暴露为独家使用液体电子烟，要获得相同精度的电子烟特异性估计，需要约四倍的暴露事件。重复筛查设计在每次筛查时更新戒烟情况和产品使用情况，已在同一数据库中用于戒烟研究，将保留完整样本并允许更精确的、产品特异性的剂量-反应估计。

papers.title: Privacy-Preserving Large Language Model Deployment for Oncology Registry Abstraction: Structure-Aware Evaluation in a Real-World Clinical Setting
papers.translated_title: 面向肿瘤登记信息提取的隐私保护大语言模型部署：真实临床环境中的结构感知评估
papers.author: Moldovan, M.
papers.summary: Objectives Structuring oncology clinical notes into registry-grade variables is essential for research and care but remains labour-intensive and error-prone. This study developed and evaluated a privacy-preserving large language model pipeline for oncology registry abstraction in a real-world clinical setting. Methods An open-source Meta Llama 3.3 70B-based pipeline, prompted without task-specific fine-tuning, was deployed to extract over 50 variables from 6,700 oncology notes at a cancer centre in Singapore. Data were de-identified locally using a Hide-In-Plain-Sight approach, ensuring no identifiable data left hospital infrastructure. Performance was assessed on 200 randomly sampled notes with adjudicated ground truth, using a structure-aware framework that classified outputs as correct, missing, spurious, or incorrect. Results F1 scores were high across variables, including diagnosis (97.2%), histology (95.8%), stage (92.6%), biomarkers (91.4%), and treatments (88.1%). Preliminary transferability testing on 50 external notes showed strong performance for core diagnostic variables, with reduced performance for list-valued variables. Discussion The structure-aware evaluation approach separated omissions from fabrications, providing more clinically actionable insight than aggregate metrics alone. Conclusion Privacy-preserving large language models achieved high extraction accuracy under a clinician-verified reference standard, supporting their feasibility for oncology registry abstraction in real-world clinical settings. Keywords: Large language models; Oncology registry abstraction; Natural language processing; Privacy-preserving AI; Clinical data extraction What is already known on this topic Structuring oncology clinical notes into registry-grade variables is essential for cancer research and care but remains labour-intensive, costly, and inconsistent from one reviewer to the next when performed manually. Large language models offer potential to automate this task, but their use in real-world registries has been limited by concerns over patient data privacy, reliance on task-specific fine-tuning, and evaluation methods that obscure the difference between missing and fabricated information. What this study adds This study shows that an open-source, privacy-preserving large language model pipeline, deployed entirely within hospital infrastructure without task-specific fine-tuning, can extract over 50 registry variables from oncology notes with high accuracy (F1 scores 88-97% across key variables), validated against ground truth checked by two clinicians. Using a structure-aware evaluation framework, we demonstrate that errors can be meaningfully separated into missing, spurious, and incorrect categories, offering clearer insight into model behaviour than aggregate accuracy metrics alone, and show preliminary evidence of transferability to notes from an external setting. How this study might affect research, practice or policy These findings support the feasibility of deploying privacy-preserving, locally hosted large language models for oncology registry abstraction without requiring identifiable data to leave hospital systems or extensive model customisation. The structure-aware evaluation framework is also shared as a reusable template, enabling other institutions to validate similar AI extraction tools in a consistent, clinically meaningful way before wider implementation.
papers.translated_summary: 目标 将肿瘤学临床记录结构化为登记级变量对于研究和诊疗至关重要，但目前仍劳动密集且容易出错。本研究开发并评估了一种隐私保护的大语言模型流水线，用于在真实临床环境中进行肿瘤学登记数据提取。方法 在新加坡一家癌症中心部署了一个基于开源Meta Llama 3.3 70B的流水线，无需任务特定微调即可提示，从6，700份肿瘤学记录中提取50多个变量。数据在本地使用Hide-In-Plain-Sight方法进行去标识化，确保没有可识别数据离开医院基础设施。在200份随机抽样的记录上评估性能，以经裁定的真实标签为参考，采用结构感知框架将输出分类为正确、缺失、虚假或错误。结果 各变量的F1分数较高，包括诊断（97.2%）、组织学（95.8%）、分期（92.6%）、生物标志物（91.4%）和治疗（88.1%）。在50份外部记录上的初步可迁移性测试显示，核心诊断变量表现良好，但列表值变量表现下降。讨论 结构感知评估方法将遗漏与捏造区分开来，比仅使用聚合指标提供更具临床可操作性的洞察。结论 隐私保护大语言模型在经临床医生验证的参考标准下实现了高提取准确率，支持其在真实临床环境中用于肿瘤学登记数据提取的可行性。关键词：大语言模型；肿瘤学登记数据提取；自然语言处理；隐私保护AI；临床数据提取 关于本主题的已知信息 将肿瘤学临床记录结构化为登记级变量对于癌症研究和诊疗至关重要，但手动执行时仍然劳动密集、成本高昂，且不同审阅者之间不一致。大语言模型有潜力实现该任务自动化，但其在真实世界登记中的应用受到患者数据隐私担忧、对任务特定微调的依赖，以及掩盖缺失信息与捏造信息差异的评估方法的限制。本研究新增的内容 本研究表明，一个开源、隐私保护的大语言模型流水线完全部署在医院基础设施内，无需任务特定微调，即可从肿瘤学记录中高准确率地提取50多个登记变量（关键变量的F1分数为88-97%），并经过两名临床医生核查的真实标签验证。使用结构感知评估框架，我们证明错误可以有意义地分为缺失、虚假和错误类别，比仅使用聚合准确率指标更清晰地洞察模型行为，并展示了对外部环境记录可迁移性的初步证据。本研究可能对研究、实践或政策的影响 这些发现支持部署隐私保护、本地托管的大语言模型用于肿瘤学登记数据提取的可行性，无需可识别数据离开医院系统或进行大量模型定制。结构感知评估框架还作为可复用模板共享，使其他机构能够在更广泛实施前以一致、具有临床意义的方式验证类似的AI提取工具。

papers.title: Left Ventricular Diastolic Intraventricular Pressure Differences and Propagation Velocity with 4D-Flow MRI in Patients with Hypertrophic Cardiomyopathy
papers.translated_title: 肥厚型心肌病患者左心室舒张期室内压力差与传播速度的4D血流磁共振成像研究
papers.author: Stipechi, L. V.
papers.summary: Background: Transthoracic echocardiography (TTE) remains the gold standard for assessing left ventricular (LV) diastolic dysfunction (DD), but noninvasive alternatives are needed to overcome geometric and acoustic limitations. 4D-Flow MRI enables comprehensive assessment of intraventricular pressure differences (IVPDs) and flow propagation velocity (VP). We aimed to evaluate 4D-Flow-derived IVPDs and VP in patients with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM). Methods: Thirty-eight HCM patients and 38 age- and sex-matched healthy controls underwent TTE and 4D-Flow MRI. Spatiotemporal maps of velocity and IVPDs, decomposed into inertial and convective components, were derived along the main inflow streamline from the mitral valve to the apex. Peak early filling rate (PEFR) was used to normalize IVPDs and VP. Results: While absolute peak flow rates were comparable, HCM patients exhibited significantly faster VP (100.4 vs. 60.2 cm/s, p < 0.01) and higher positive early E IVPD (1.40 vs. 0.92 mmHg, p < 0.01) compared to controls. Normalizing IVPDs by PEFR amplified group differences, revealing a markedly increased flow-normalized E-IVPD (5.13 vs. 2.94 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s, p < 0.001) and deeper reverse ER IVPD (-6.06 vs. -4.61 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s, p < 0.01) in HCM. These differences were primarily driven by the inertial components. Multivariable analysis demonstrated that ER IVPD is independently determined by PEFR and the TTE E/E' ratio (r = 0.65, p < 0.001). Conclusions: 4D-Flow MRI-derived, flow-normalized IVPDs and propagation velocity provide robust, noninvasive markers of altered LV chamber stiffness and impaired diastolic filling in HCM, offering deeper 3D hemodynamic insights into diastolic dysfunction.
papers.translated_summary: 背景：经胸超声心动图（TTE）仍是评估左心室（LV）舒张功能障碍（DD）的金标准，但需要无创替代方法来克服几何学和声学限制。4D-Flow MRI能够全面评估心室内压力差（IVPDs）和血流传播速度（VP）。本研究旨在评估肥厚型心肌病（HCM）患者中4D-Flow衍生的IVPDs和VP。方法：38例HCM患者和38例年龄、性别匹配的健康对照者接受了TTE和4D-Flow MRI检查。沿从二尖瓣到心尖的主要流入流线，推导出速度和IVPDs的时空图，并将其分解为惯性分量和对流分量。采用峰值早期充盈率（PEFR）对IVPDs和VP进行归一化。结果：虽然绝对峰值流量相当，但与对照组相比，HCM患者表现出显著更快的VP（100.4 vs. 60.2 cm/s，p < 0.01）和更高的正向早期E IVPD（1.40 vs. 0.92 mmHg，p < 0.01）。通过PEFR对IVPDs进行归一化放大了组间差异，揭示HCM中血流归一化E-IVPD显著增加（5.13 vs. 2.94 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s，p < 0.001）以及更深的反向ER IVPD（-6.06 vs. -4.61 x 103 mmHg.ml1.s，p < 0.01）。这些差异主要由惯性分量驱动。多变量分析表明，ER IVPD由PEFR和TTE E/E'比值独立决定（r = 0.65，p < 0.001）。结论：4D-Flow MRI衍生的、血流归一化的IVPDs和传播速度提供了稳健的无创标志物，可反映HCM中左心室腔僵硬度改变和舒张充盈受损，为舒张功能障碍提供了更深入的三维血流动力学见解。

papers.title: Natural Language Processing Based Solution for Labeling Brain Metastasis Identified in Radiology Reports
papers.translated_title: 基于自然语言处理的放射学报告中识别出的脑转移瘤标注解决方案
papers.author: Liu, T.
papers.summary: Abstract Purpose: Brain metastases (BM) far exceed primary CNS tumours and constitute the majority workload for neuro-oncology care providers. Currently, the cancer registries only capture synchronous BMs, which is only a small proportion of all BMs. We aim to develop and validate a natural language processing (NLP) algorithm that identifies brain metastases in radiology reports, enabling scalable surveillance of asynchronous BMs. Methods: Using population-based cancer registry data in Alberta, Canada, we identified a cancer cohort diagnosed between 2012--2019 with follow-up to 2022. All brain/head radiology reports at and post-cancer diagnosis were identified. Reports were sampled through a multi-phase approach and manually labeled for BM presence. We trained two Bio_ClinicalBERT models on the "Findings" and "Impressions" sections, respectively, and took the maximum predicted probability as the report-level prediction. Internal and external validation used reports from the Canadian provinces of Alberta, Ontario, and British Columbia. Results: The models were trained on 1,879 samples. For internal validation, 1,833 reports from 357 patients were tested. At a probability threshold of 0.4, the model achieved a sensitivity of 0.888 and precision of 0.499. The ensemble substantially outperformed single-section models, which achieved sensitivities of only 0.678 (Findings) and 0.742 (Impressions). On external validation, sensitivity was 0.837 in Ontario and 0.726 in British Columbia, demonstrating robustness across diverse data sources. Conclusions: An NLP-based pipeline processing both Findings and Impressions sections has been developed and validated in three Canadian provinces. It meets cancer registry operational requirements and to be implemented into the surveillance workflow in Alberta and British Columbia, providing a foundation for population-level BM surveillance. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/valerie-lth/BM-NLP.
papers.translated_summary: 摘要 目的：脑转移瘤（BM）的数量远超原发性中枢神经系统肿瘤，构成了神经肿瘤诊疗机构的主要工作负荷。目前，癌症登记系统仅能捕获同步性脑转移瘤，而这仅占所有脑转移瘤的一小部分。我们旨在开发并验证一种自然语言处理（NLP）算法，用于从放射学报告中识别脑转移瘤，从而实现对异步性脑转移瘤的可扩展监测。方法：利用加拿大艾伯塔省基于人群的癌症登记数据，我们确定了2012至2019年间诊断、随访至2022年的癌症队列。识别了癌症诊断时及诊断后的所有脑部/头部放射学报告。报告通过多阶段方法进行抽样，并人工标注脑转移瘤的存在情况。我们分别在“所见”和“印象”部分训练了两个Bio_ClinicalBERT模型，并取最大预测概率作为报告级别的预测结果。内部和外部验证使用了来自加拿大艾伯塔省、安大略省和不列颠哥伦比亚省的报告。结果：模型在1，879个样本上进行训练。内部验证中，测试了来自357名患者的1，833份报告。在概率阈值为0.4时，模型的灵敏度为0.888，精确率为0.499。集成模型显著优于单部分模型，后者灵敏度分别仅为0.678（所见）和0.742（印象）。外部验证中，安大略省灵敏度为0.837，不列颠哥伦比亚省为0.726，表明其在不同数据来源间具有稳健性。结论：已开发出一种同时处理“所见”和“印象”部分的基于NLP的流程，并在加拿大三个省份进行了验证。该流程满足癌症登记系统的操作要求，将被纳入艾伯塔省和不列颠哥伦比亚省的监测工作流程，为人群水平的脑转移瘤监测奠定基础。我们的代码公开 available at: https://github.com/valerie-lth/BM-NLP。

papers.title: Network responses to meditation and baseline connectivity correlates of cognitive improvement in schizophrenia
papers.translated_title: 精神分裂症患者对冥想的网络反应及认知改善的基线连接相关性
papers.author: Wang, Q.
papers.summary: Meditation based rehabilitation may improve symptoms and cognition in schizophrenia, but how these responses relate to changes in brain network interactions remains unclear. We conducted a secondary analysis of longitudinal clinical assessments and resting-state functional MRI at baseline, 3 and 8 months in a randomized trial of 64 male inpatients comparing meditation-based rehabilitation with general rehabilitation. Each analysis included all participants with the required measurements: 62 for clinical, 44 for three-visit connectivity and 43 for joint neural clinical models. Symptom treatment effects increased between months 3 and 8, whereas cognitive benefit was clearest at 3 months. In the clinical cross-lagged panel model, early cognitive improvement was associated with cumulative symptom improvement at 8 months (beta = 0.136; nominal P = 0.044); bootstrap intervals included zero for this association and the indirect treatment effect. Intrinsic network properties showed no treatment contrasts surviving multiplicity correction. Spectral dynamic causal modelling and parametric empirical Bayes identified eight treatment-associated connections shared across models with and without head-motion adjustment. Two early effects were consistent across five model specifications, sharing a supramarginal frontal source with sensorimotor and bilateral middle frontal targets. Adding baseline connectivity and early changes in these connections to clinical and motion covariates increased conditional in sample R2 most for 3-month cognitive improvement, by 0.147. Baseline connectivity supplied most of this increment (0.125); its two associations, modelled as common across treatment arms, retained their directions across all participant omissions. Early change associations with clinical outcomes were imprecise. These findings distinguish treatment-responsive network interactions from the baseline connectivity that adds most information about cognitive improvement. They motivate a testable account in which initial sensory attention coordination supports engagement with rehabilitation, while changing practice demands shape network responses.
papers.translated_summary: 基于冥想的康复可能改善精神分裂症患者的症状和认知，但这些反应与脑网络相互作用变化之间的关系仍不清楚。我们在一项随机试验的二次分析中，对64名男性住院患者进行了纵向临床评估和静息态功能MRI分析，时间点包括基线、3个月和8个月，比较基于冥想的康复与一般康复。每项分析均纳入具有所需测量数据的全部参与者：临床分析62人，三次访视连接性分析44人，联合神经-临床模型分析43人。症状治疗效果在3至8个月间增加，而认知获益在3个月时最为明显。在临床交叉滞后面板模型中，早期认知改善与8个月时累积症状改善相关（beta = 0.136；名义P = 0.044）；该关联及间接治疗效应的bootstrap区间均包含零。内在网络属性未显示经多重性校正后仍存活的治疗对比。谱动态因果建模和参数经验贝叶斯识别出八个治疗相关连接，这些连接在有无头动校正的模型中共享。两个早期效应在五种模型设定中一致，共享一个缘上回额叶源，靶向感觉运动区和双侧中额叶。将基线连接性和这些连接的早期变化加入临床及运动协变量后，条件样本内R2增加最多的是3个月认知改善，增量为0.147。基线连接性贡献了该增量的大部分（0.125）；其两个关联被建模为跨治疗组共通，在所有参与者剔除分析中均保持方向不变。早期变化与临床结局的关联不精确。这些发现区分了治疗反应性网络相互作用与基线连接性，后者提供了关于认知改善的大部分信息。它们引出一个可检验的解释：初始感觉注意协调支持康复参与，而不断变化的练习需求塑造网络反应。

papers.title: Multi-agent LLM diagnostic teams improve differential recall on curated cases and reverse on real emergency notes: a label-level reversal without a clinician-judged safety difference
papers.translated_title: 多智能体大语言模型诊断团队在精选病例上提高了鉴别诊断召回率，但在真实急诊记录上出现逆转：一种标签层面的逆转，而临床医生判定的安全性并无差异
papers.author: Feng, J.
papers.summary: Background. Multi-agent large language model (LLM) pipelines are proposed for diagnostic support, but when they help or harm is unknown: evaluations use curated case reports, rarely include budget-matched controls, or isolate perspective independence. Methods. We compared a single direct call (Ax1), five specialist personas voiced within one context (P), and the same five roles run as isolated, mutually blinded agents integrated by a moderator (MDT), with five repeat runs per case, on 87 clinicopathological conference (CPC) cases, 406 MedCaseReasoning cases, 364 emergency-department encounters, and a protocol-frozen 392-vignette replication cohort, scored by an LLM judge validated against blinded clinicians, with a three-physician blinded safety rating of the discordant pairs. Findings. On curated vignettes the moderated team improved the pre-specified recall endpoints, not top-1 accuracy (CPC +5.5, MedCaseReasoning +3.0, replication +3.3 points at top-3; p = 0.0079, 0.0079, 0.0013); a factorial attributed the gain to independent generation plus moderated synthesis, not personas. On 364 real emergency notes (labels: clinicians' working diagnoses, 46% symptom-level), the direction reversed (top-3 -6.4 points, p = 0.0022), widened with objective results, and replicated in a second open-weight family. A five-corpus dose-response is consistent with input curation driving the sign (post hoc; corpora differ in provenance and granularity). A symptom-permissive output contract closed the reversal's breadth end but not its ordering end, and blinded physicians judged neither strategy's errors more dangerous (68% ties; a null powered for large effects only). Interpretation. Multi-agent pipelines are input-conditional: they improve differential-list recall (not top-1 accuracy) on curated inputs and underperform on uncurated emergency text - a label-level reversal without a clinician-judged safety difference. Strategy selection should key on the input and model family, observable before the model runs, as a routing hypothesis; curated-benchmark gains should not be extrapolated to front-line care.
papers.translated_summary: 背景。多智能体大语言模型（LLM）流水线被提出用于诊断支持，但其何时有益或有害尚不清楚：评估使用精选病例报告，很少包含预算匹配的对照，或隔离视角独立性。方法。我们比较了单次直接调用（Ax1）、在单一上下文中表达的五位专家角色（P），以及作为隔离、相互盲视的智能体运行并由主持人整合的相同五个角色（MDT），每例重复运行五次，在87例临床病理讨论会（CPC）病例、406例MedCaseReasoning病例、364例急诊科就诊记录，以及一个方案冻结的392例情景复现队列上进行，由经盲法临床医生验证的LLM评判者评分，并对不一致配对进行三名医生的盲法安全性评级。发现。在精选情景上，主持团队改善了预设的召回终点，而非top-1准确率（CPC +5.5、MedCaseReasoning +3.0、复现 +3.3个百分点，top-3；p = 0.0079、0.0079、0.0013）；析因分析将增益归因于独立生成加主持整合，而非角色设定。在364份真实急诊记录上（标签：临床医生的工作诊断，46%为症状层面），方向逆转（top-3 -6.4个百分点，p = 0.0022），随客观结果而扩大，并在第二个开放权重家族中复现。五语料剂量-反应与输入精选驱动符号一致（事后；语料在来源和粒度上不同）。症状宽松的输出契约缩小了逆转的广度端但未缩小其排序端，盲法医生判定两种策略的错误均不更危险（68%平局；仅对大型效应有检验力的零结果）。解释。多智能体流水线是输入条件性的：它们在精选输入上改善鉴别列表召回（而非top-1准确率），在未精选的急诊文本上表现不佳——这是一种标签层面的逆转，而无临床医生判定的安全性差异。策略选择应基于输入和模型家族，在模型运行前即可观察，作为路由假设；精选基准的增益不应外推到一线照护。

papers.title: MULTIMODAL EEG WORLD MODEL: SELF-SUPERVISED LATENT TRANSITION LEARNING FOR WEARABLE EEG SEIZURE DETECTION
papers.translated_title: 多模态脑电世界模型：面向可穿戴脑电癫痫检测的自监督潜在状态转移动学习
papers.author: Yin, Z.
papers.summary: Existing supervised and self-supervised EEG models mainly learn within-segment discriminative or reconstructive representations, leaving transitions between adjacent EEG segments underexplored. We propose a self-supervised Multimodal EEG World Model for EEG seizure detection that predicts the latent representation of the next EEG segment from the current EEG state, conditioned on synchronized ECG, EMG, and movement signals. A learnable query-based fusion module aggregates the multimodal synchronized signals into a compact physiological condition. Pretraining uses no seizure labels; downstream detection retains only the frozen EEG encoder and a linear probe. On the SeizeIT2 dataset with a strict patient-wise split, the model achieved an AUPRC of 0.3748, ROC-AUC of 0.8025, and balanced accuracy of 0.7308, outperforming official database baselines (SVM with hand-crafted features and ChronoNet), an external baseline (DSAINet), and a foundation model (NeuroLM). Ablations show a 14.4% relative AUPRC gain over a random-initialized encoder, supporting multimodal-conditioned latent transition learning for wearable EEG representation learning.
papers.translated_summary: 现有的监督和自监督EEG模型主要学习片段内的判别性或重建性表征，对相邻EEG片段之间的过渡关注不足。我们提出了一种用于EEG癫痫检测的自监督多模态EEG世界模型，该模型以同步的ECG、EMG和运动信号为条件，从当前EEG状态预测下一个EEG片段的潜在表征。一个基于可学习查询的融合模块将多模态同步信号聚合为紧凑的生理条件。预训练不使用癫痫标签；下游检测仅保留冻结的EEG编码器和线性探针。在采用严格按患者划分的SeizeIT2数据集上，该模型取得了0.3748的AUPRC、0.8025的ROC-AUC和0.7308的平衡准确率，优于官方数据库基线（使用手工特征的SVM和ChronoNet）、外部基线（DSAINet）以及基础模型（NeuroLM）。消融实验表明，相较于随机初始化编码器，AUPRC相对提升14.4%，支持了多模态条件潜在过渡学习用于可穿戴EEG表征学习的有效性。

papers.title: Seeded Probes Do Not Identify a Reviewer's Miss Rate: One-Sided Misclassification in Distribution-Free Risk Control
papers.translated_title: 种子探针无法识别审稿人的漏检率：无分布风险控制中的单侧误分类
papers.author: Kotabhattara, K. C.
papers.summary: Distribution-free risk control certifies that the rate of defects that would change clinical management, among the answers an AI system releases, stays below a stated level, calibrated on cases a human reviewer has checked. The reviewer is an imperfect reference standard whose errors run one way: a missed defect enters calibration as a safe label. This one-sided misclassification lowers the risk on record at every release threshold, so the certificate is anti-conservative by a factor set by the reviewer's miss rate on the system's own defects. We show that seeded probes, which plant known defects and count the catches, do not identify this miss rate. A reviewer's chance of missing a defect depends on how hard that defect is to spot, its detectability. A probe samples defects at detectabilities its designer chose. The system's own defects fall at detectabilities nothing chose, and converting the probe's miss rate into theirs requires the very rate being sought. This holds whenever detectability is not fully captured by an observed score, since a score that captured it would let probes covering its range identify the rate. Cytology field validation builds probe sets whose miss rate is a floor on the true one. Even then the probe bounds the rate from below only, so it can reject a certificate and cannot grant one. The finite-sample label-noise corrections assume noise independent of the case given its label, but a reviewer misses the defects that read as plausible, and the condition they need fails in all four simulated reviewer profiles we examine. Testing that condition on an independent sample takes 185 adjudicated cases for a reviewer missing 85% of defects and 147,938 for one missing 3%. A second reader who adjudicates the cases the careful reviewer passed finds a miss with 95% confidence within 498, so looking for the noise directly costs far less than testing a model of it. In a public corpus of model answers graded by physicians, a physician passed 26.3% of the defects the other graders agreed were there (95% interval 21.6% to 31.7%, resampling whole conversations), on criteria about seeking context and stating uncertainty, and individual rates ran from 8.0% to 54.5%.
papers.translated_summary: 无分布风险控制证明，在AI系统发布的答案中，会改变临床管理的缺陷率保持在规定水平以下，并以人工审核者已检查的病例进行校准。审核者是一个不完美的参考标准，其错误是单向的：被漏掉的缺陷在 calibration 中以安全标签进入。这种单向误分类降低了每个发布阈值下记录的风险，因此证书的反保守程度由一个因子决定，该因子由审核者在系统自身缺陷上的漏检率设定。我们表明，种子探针——植入已知缺陷并统计捕获数量——无法识别这一漏检率。审核者漏掉缺陷的概率取决于该缺陷有多难被发现，即其可检测性。探针以其设计者选择的可检测性对缺陷进行采样。系统自身的缺陷落在无人选择的可检测性上，而将探针的漏检率转换为系统自身缺陷的漏检率，需要正是所要寻求的那个比率。只要可检测性未被观测分数完全捕捉，这一点就成立，因为一个能捕捉它的分数将允许覆盖其范围的探针识别该比率。细胞学现场验证构建的探针集，其漏检率是真实漏检率的下限。即便如此，探针仅从下方界定该比率，因此它可以拒绝证书，但不能授予证书。有限样本标签噪声校正假设噪声在给定标签下与病例独立，但审核者会漏掉那些读起来似乎合理的缺陷，而它们所需的条件在我们考察的全部四种模拟审核者配置中都不成立。在独立样本上检验该条件，对于漏检85%缺陷的审核者需要185个经裁定的病例，对于漏检3%的审核者需要147,938个。第二位读者对仔细审核者通过的病例进行裁定，在498个病例内以95%置信度发现一次漏检，因此直接寻找噪声的成本远低于检验其模型。在一个由医生评分的模型答案公开语料库中，一位医生在其他评分者一致认为存在的缺陷中通过了26.3%（95%区间21.6%至31.7%，重采样整个对话），涉及寻求上下文和陈述不确定性等标准，个体比率从8.0%到54.5%不等。

papers.title: Association of neurotransmitter-based polygenic scores with antidepressant treatment outcomes in patients with major depressive disorder
papers.translated_title: 基于神经递质的多基因评分与重度抑郁症患者抗抑郁治疗结局的关联
papers.author: Sharew, N. T.
papers.summary: Biologically informed polygenic scores (PGSs) may help interpret genetic associations with treatment outcomes. Here, we computed neurotransmitter-based PGSs (NeuroPGSs) for patients with major depressive disorder (MDD) and assessed their association with SSRI treatment outcomes. By targeting genetic variants involved in key neurotransmission pathways, we developed PGSs for serotonergic (5228), gamma-aminobutyric acid (GABA, 4103), dopaminergic (7061), and glutamatergic (5690) variants. We leveraged data from two cohorts of patients who received SSRIs for at least 4 weeks: the International SSRI Pharmacogenomics Consortium (ISPC) and the Pharmacogenomics Research Network Antidepressants Medication Pharmacogenomics Study (PGRN-AMPS). Treatment response was defined as [≥]50% reduction from baseline depression symptoms, measured using 17-item Hamilton Rating Scale for Depression (HRSD-17) in ISPC and 16-item Quick Inventory of Depressive Symptomatology (QIDS-C16) in PGRN-AMPS. Remission was defined as HRSD-17 [≤]7 (ISPC) or QIDS-C16[≤]5 (PGRN-AMPS). The association between each NeuroPGS and antidepressant response or remission was evaluated using logistic regression models, adjusting for age, sex and five genetic principal components, with statistical significance determined at Benjamini Hochberg-adjusted p<0.05. The GABAergic-based PGS was associated with SSRI response (aOR per SD = 1.45, 95%CI: 1.14-1.85). Patients with the highest GABAergic PGS (10th decile) had 2.59-fold higher odds of response (95%CI: 1.46-4.60) compared to those with the lowest decile (1st decile). These exploratory findings support further evaluation of NeuroPGSs; independent replication and assessment of incremental predictive value are needed before clinical application. Keywords: Polygenic score; Neurotransmitters; GABAergic; depression; SSRIs; pharmacogenomics
papers.translated_summary: 生物学启发的多基因评分（PGSs）可能有助于解释遗传与治疗结局之间的关联。在此，我们计算了重度抑郁症（MDD）患者基于神经递质的多基因评分（NeuroPGSs），并评估其与SSRI治疗结局的关联。通过靶向参与关键神经传递通路的遗传变异，我们开发了针对5-羟色胺能（5228）、γ-氨基丁酸（GABA，4103）、多巴胺能（7061）和谷氨酸能（5690）变异的PGSs。我们利用了接受SSRIs治疗至少4周的两个患者队列的数据：国际SSRI药物基因组学联盟（ISPC）和药物基因组学研究网络抗抑郁药物药物基因组学研究（PGRN-AMPS）。治疗反应定义为基线抑郁症状减少≥50%，在ISPC中使用17项汉密尔顿抑郁评定量表（HRSD-17）测量，在PGRN-AMPS中使用16项抑郁症状快速清单（QIDS-C16）测量。缓解定义为HRSD-17≤7（ISPC）或QIDS-C16≤5（PGRN-AMPS）。使用逻辑回归模型评估每个NeuroPGS与抗抑郁反应或缓解之间的关联，并调整年龄、性别和五个遗传主成分，统计显著性在Benjamini Hochberg校正p<0.05水平确定。基于GABA能的PGS与SSRI反应相关（每标准差aOR = 1.45，95%CI：1.14-1.85）。GABA能PGS最高的患者（第10十分位）相比最低十分位（第1十分位）的患者，反应几率高2.59倍（95%CI：1.46-4.60）。这些探索性发现支持进一步评估NeuroPGSs；在临床应用之前，需要独立复制和评估增量预测价值。关键词：多基因评分；神经递质；GABA能；抑郁症；SSRIs；药物基因组学
